en.headline: CHP investigates invasive meningococcal infection in 74-year-old man
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the patient, who has an underlying illness, is in stable condition at Kwong Wah Hospital after no travel during the incubation period.
body: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a case of invasive meningococcal infection involving a 74-year-old man with an underlying illness.

The patient developed fever and malaise on 19 November and consulted a private doctor the following day. His condition deteriorated that day and he was admitted to Kwong Wah Hospital via the accident and emergency department. He remains in stable condition. Laboratory testing of cerebrospinal fluid confirmed meningococcus, and the clinical diagnosis is meningitis.

An initial investigation found no travel history during the incubation period. Family members have shown no symptoms so far and have been given preventive medication. The centre said the case appears sporadic and its investigation is continuing.

Meningococcal infection is a statutory notifiable disease. The centre has recorded six cases so far this year, compared with 11 for the whole of last year. It reminded the public to maintain good personal and environmental hygiene.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查74歲男子感染侵入性腦膜炎雙球菌
zh.dek: 中心指該名有長期病患的患者目前在廣華醫院情況穩定，潛伏期內沒有外遊，初步屬散發個案。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心正調查一宗侵入性腦膜炎雙球菌感染個案，涉及一名有長期病患的74歲男子。
患者本月19日開始發燒及全身乏力，翌日向私家醫生求診，同日情況惡化，被送到廣華醫院急症室並入院治療，目前情況穩定。腦脊液樣本化驗證實對腦膜炎雙球菌呈陽性，臨床診斷為腦膜炎。
初步調查顯示，患者潛伏期內沒有外遊紀錄。家庭成員至今沒有出現病徵，並已獲處方預防藥物。中心指個案初步屬散發性質，調查仍在進行。
侵入性腦膜炎雙球菌感染是法定須呈報傳染病。中心今年至今錄得6宗個案，去年全年則有11宗。中心提醒市民時刻注意個人及環境衞生。
Correction: 更正中文正文第二段「翌日」，上一版本誤作「翼日」。
